# LEI legal entity: lei-entity (LEI)

A legal entity from its LEI record: key facts, addresses, registration and renewal, parents, children and identifiers. One row per lei legal entity, keyed by LEI. Read by the **gleif** pack's connector `gleif-store` (table `<root>/gleif/lei-entity/`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-25 from GLEIF LEI records, relationship records and mapping files (tools/publicdata/gleif.py), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 9,937 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/gleif/lei-entity/` + `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `LEI` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `LEI`, `NAME`, `LEI_COUNTRY`, `LEGAL_CITY`, `LEGAL_FORM`, `REGISTRATION_STATUS`, `RENEWAL_LATE`, `SEGMENT`, `NEXT_RENEWAL`, `US_COMPANY` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## Sub-types

The rows come in 4 sub-types, recognised by `CATEGORY` (blank: a general entity). Each has its own most complete record below; the fields every sub-type's record has are in one shared table first.

| Sub-type | Recognised by | Rows | Sample from | Section |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **General entity** | `CATEGORY` empty | 9,724 | test data | [General entity](#general-entity) |
| **Fund** | `CATEGORY` `Fund` | 207 | test data | [Fund](#fund) |
| **Branch** | `CATEGORY` `Branch` | 5 | test data | [Branch](#branch) |
| **Government entity** | `CATEGORY` `Government entity` | 1 | test data | [Government entity](#government-entity) |

## Fields every sub-type has

The example is from the **General entity** record.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | string | required | The entity's Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442): 20 characters, letters and digits; the record's key. | pattern `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$` | `"4KF48RN45X1OO8UBLY20"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The entity's legal name (GLEIF entity.legalName). | — | `"XEROX CORPORATION"` |
| `OTHER_NAMES` | array of objects | optional (filled in 32% of rows) | The entity's other names in GLEIF (otherNames, then transliteratedOtherNames), at most two, one element each: NAME and TYPE (previous legal name, trading or operating name, …). | — | [2 objects] |
| `OTHER_NAMES[].NAME` | string | required | Another name of the entity. | — | `"THE HALOID COMPANY"` |
| `OTHER_NAMES[].TYPE` | string | required | What kind of name it is (previous legal name, trading or operating name, transliterated legal name...). | one of `alternative language legal name`, `auto ascii transliterated legal name`, `preferred ascii transliterated legal name`, `previous legal name`, `trading or operating name` | `"previous legal name"` |
| `LEGAL_FORM` | string | required | The entity's legal form, as the ISO 20275 entity legal form code's name (GLEIF legalForm), or the code itself (9999 and the like) when it has no name. | — | `"Business Corporation"` |
| `LEI_COUNTRY` | string | required | The country of the entity's legal address, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US, GB …): a country of the computed lei-country kind. | links to `lei-country` | `"US"` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | required | The name of the legal address's country (LEI_COUNTRY), from the ISO 3166 list. | — | `"United States of America (the)"` |
| `LEGAL_ADDRESS` | string | required | The entity's legal address on one line: street lines, postal code, city, region and country, as GLEIF gives them. | — | `"C/O CORPORATION SERVICE COMPANY, 80 STATE STREET, 12207 AL…` |
| `LEGAL_CITY` | string | required | The city of the legal address. | — | `"ALBANY"` |
| `ENTITY_STATUS` | string | required | Whether the entity itself still exists: ACTIVE or INACTIVE (GLEIF entity status), or NULL as GLEIF gives it. | seen: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, `NULL` | `"ACTIVE"` |
| `CREATED` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 91% of rows) | The date the legal entity was established (GLEIF entityCreationDate), YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"1906-04-18"` |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | string | required | The LEI's registration status in GLEIF (ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED, MERGED, PENDING_TRANSFER...). | seen: `ISSUED`, `LAPSED`, `RETIRED`, `DUPLICATE` | `"ISSUED"` |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the LEI was first issued (GLEIF initialRegistrationDate), YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2012-10-17"` |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date GLEIF's record was last changed (lastUpdateDate), YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-09-25"` |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the LEI must be renewed by (nextRenewalDate), YYYY-MM-DD; a date before the retrieval date means the LEI has lapsed. | — | `"2027-09-30"` |
| `RENEWAL_LATE` | boolean | required | true when the registration has lapsed or its next renewal date has passed (the record was not renewed in time). | seen: `false`, `true` | `false` |
| `MANAGING_LOU` | string | required | The Local Operating Unit that manages the LEI (GLEIF managingLou), by name when GLEIF's list names it, else its LEI. | — | `"Bloomberg Finance L.P."` |
| `LEI_GROUP` | string | required | The entity's ownership group: the LEI of its ultimate parent (the entity's own LEI when it has none), the id of the computed lei-group kind. | links to `lei-group` | `"5493000Y33XDVO2CXC18"` |
| `DIRECT_CHILDREN_GLEIF` | integer | optional (filled in 16% of rows) | How many entities report this one as their direct parent in GLEIF level 2 data (all of GLEIF, not only the pack). | — | `6` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (GLEIF golden copy and mapping files), RETRIEVED_AT (YYYY-MM-DD), LICENCE (CC0) and URL (the record on search.gleif.org). | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The public source of the record (GLEIF LEI records, level 2 relationships and mapping files). | — | `"GLEIF, the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (LEI …` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date GLEIF's data was retrieved (YYYY-MM-DD). | — | `"2026-10-25"` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The licence of the source (CC0 1.0). | — | `"CC0 1.0 (GLEIF's terms: free of charge, no restriction; at…` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The LEI's record on search.gleif.org. | — | `"https://search.gleif.org/#/record/4KF48RN45X1OO8UBLY20"` |

## One record of each sub-type

Each record is real, the most complete of its sub-type, pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data. Below each record, the fields it has beyond the shared table.

| `PARENT_EXCEPTIONS[].LEVEL` | string | required | Which parent the exception is for: Direct parent or Ultimate parent. | one of `Direct parent`, `Ultimate parent` | `"Direct parent"` |

| `PARENT_EXCEPTIONS[].MEANING` | string | required | The reason in words ("Controlled by natural persons, not by an entity"); the code in lower case when the pack has no wording for it. | one of `Controlled by natural persons, not by an entity`, `No known person controls it (shares widely held)`, `The parent does not consolidate it (no consolidated accounts that include it)`, `The parent may not be disclosed (legal obstacle or harm)`, `no lei` | `"no lei"` |
| `CHILDREN` | array of objects | optional (filled in 13% of rows) | The entity's direct children that are in the pack, one element each: LEI, NAME, COUNTRY (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and KIDS (how many children it has in turn). | — | [6 objects] |

| `CHILD_COUNT` | integer | optional (filled in 13% of rows) | How many of the entity's direct children are in the pack (CHILDREN); absent when none. | — | `6` |
| `MAPPING_IDS` | array of strings | optional (filled in 6% of rows) | The entity's identifiers in GLEIF's mapping files, kept for the seed entities and the groups' ultimate parents: its BICs, MICs and a sample of its ISINs, each an IDENTIFIER of the lei-mapping kind. | links to `lei-mapping` | [6 values] |
| `SEGMENT` | string | optional (filled in 6% of rows) | Why in this pack | seen: `US equities`, `Bank`, `G-SIB`, `Insurer`, `Asset manager`, `Market infrastructure` | `"US equities"` |

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `LEI` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `LEI`, `NAME`, `LEGAL_FORM`, `LEI_COUNTRY`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `LEGAL_ADDRESS`, `LEGAL_CITY`, `ENTITY_STATUS`, `REGISTRATION_STATUS`, `INITIAL_REGISTRATION`, `LAST_UPDATE`, `NEXT_RENEWAL`, `RENEWAL_LATE`, `MANAGING_LOU`, `LEI_GROUP`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `LEI` per snapshot.
- `LEI` matches `^[0-9A-Z]{18}[0-9]{2}$`.
- `BIC_COUNT` is at least 0.
- `ISIN_COUNT` is at least 0.
- `CHILD_COUNT` is at least 0.
